keyPoints: The team is considering a touch-based graphical interface on the TV screen instead of a physical screen for navigation.
The team is discussing whether to include a screen, noting it may require an advanced chip and be more expensive.
The team is exploring tactile design ideas using fruit and vegetable themes, including spongy materials like rubber stress balls.
The team is considering integrating fruit and vegetable names or colors into the remote's design for thematic consistency.
The idea of a detachable squishy part with changeable fruit and vegetable designs is being discussed.
The possibility of using silver and yellow company colors on the remote is mentioned.
The need to place the logo on the remote and integrate batteries under the plastic case is noted.
The discussion includes alternative power sources like solar, wind-up, and dynamo, with battery being the preferred option due to cost concerns.
nextSteps: Explore cost implications for different power sources, especially batteries and chip production.
Determine how to integrate the logo and battery placement into the remote design.
Begin hands-on prototyping with play-dough to evaluate design and user interface look and feel.
